prompt: Design a high-fidelity 1536×864 desktop application comp for pod-god, a solo podcast creator. This is a designed software surface, not a poster. Use a three-zone console: a slim top project/status strip; a left production navigator taking roughly one sixth of the width with Config, Describe idea, Hosts, Format, Episodes 5, Scripts 1/5, Audio 0/5, and Player; a dominant central chat workspace headed “Make a podcast with me” using the real prompt “I need a podcast about Charlie explaining how to prompt models” and a proposed episode card for “1. Why Fable 5 Is a Different Beast”; a right contextual current-episode workbench with script progress and progressively disclosed sections; and a persistent bottom transport with waveform and render status. Use matte near-black and charcoal surfaces, fine gray seams, warm off-white text, amber only for current state and primary action, green only for success, red only for failure. Humanist sans for conversation, condensed mono for status. TP-7 is a material and control-quality reference: precise labels, compact status display, tactile transport controls, disciplined geometry. Hermes Agent is a polish and hierarchy reference: generous composition, authored moments, clear progressive sequence. No blue, gradients, glass, neon, rounded-card bento grid, fake metrics, invented project names, or decorative imagery. Project name is “Charlie — Fable 5 Prompting”. Keep dense information legible, quiet, and production-ready.
name: Three-Zone Console
